★ How Kairos works · 3-step pipeline ▼
01 Universe filter Start with S&P 500 + R1000 + custom watchlist (~1,500 tickers). Apply price $5–$250 and $10M+ daily volume filters. Drop earnings blackout (7d). Drops to ~122.
02 14-gate pipeline Run regime detection (4-state: trending/choppy/risk-off/panic). Score 5 pillars (Technical 35 · Catalyst 20 · RS 20 · Smart-money 15 · Quality 10). Apply 14 hard gates: liquidity, R:R, entry quality, sample size, Wilson floor, etc. Drops to ~52.
03 Conviction tiering Score ≥72 in choppy = BUY (T1/T2/T3 by conviction). 65-71 = WATCH. Below 65 = AVOID. Each setup mapped to one of 8 sleeves (VCP, PEAD, Insider, Squeeze, etc.). Position sizing via half-Kelly with regime + DD haircut.
